; The same three instructions as dbg-a.ll, built from a file in a different
; directory, at different line numbers, with the value-tracking intrinsic gone
; -- which is what happens between two optimisation levels. Nothing the program
; does has changed, so the fingerprint must not move.
source_filename = "another/place/entirely/sink.c"

define i32 @sink(ptr %p, i32 %v) !dbg !7 {
entry:
  store i32 %v, ptr %p, align 4, !dbg !10
  %0 = load i32, ptr %p, align 4, !dbg !11
  ret i32 %0, !dbg !12
}

!llvm.dbg.cu = !{!0}
!llvm.module.flags = !{!3, !4}

!0 = distinct !DICompileUnit(language: DW_LANG_C11, file: !1, producer: "b", isOptimized: true, runtimeVersion: 0, emissionKind: FullDebug, splitDebugInlining: false, nameTableKind: None)
!1 = !DIFile(filename: "sink.c", directory: "/another/place/entirely")
!3 = !{i32 7, !"Dwarf Version", i32 5}
!4 = !{i32 2, !"Debug Info Version", i32 3}
!7 = distinct !DISubprogram(name: "sink", scope: !1, file: !1, line: 900, type: !8, scopeLine: 900, spFlags: DISPFlagDefinition, unit: !0)
!8 = !DISubroutineType(types: !9)
!9 = !{null}
!10 = !DILocation(line: 901, column: 30, scope: !7)
!11 = !DILocation(line: 902, column: 31, scope: !7)
!12 = !DILocation(line: 903, column: 32, scope: !7)
